name: Smart Jump
description:
Smart Jump — Navigate to anywhere you want.

🔎 REST Endpoint Search (Ctrl+\):
  • Search all REST endpoints across your project in a filterable popup
  • Languages: Java, Kotlin, Python, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust
  • Frameworks: Spring, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Laravel, Symfony, Slim, Express, Koa, NestJS, Actix-web, Rocket, Axum, Gin, Echo, Chi, Sanic, JAX-RS, Jakarta, Micronaut
  • Works in any JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, RustRover, GoLand...)
Java / MyBatis:
  • Java Method ➔ MyBatis XML
  • MyBatis XML ➔ Java Method
  • MyBatis XML include refid ➔ sql fragment
  • MyBatis XML resultMap ref ➔ resultMap definition
Spring:
  • @Value("${key}") ↔ application.properties/yml
  • @Qualifier / @Resource ➔ @Bean definition
  • Feign Client method ➔ Controller endpoint
HTML / CSS / JS / TS:
  • HTML ➔ JS/CSS file
  • HTML ➔ JS function
  • Vue event ➔ JS function
  • JS/TS ➔ Controller RequestMapping
  • CSS class in code ➔ CSS/SCSS definition
  • i18n key (t/$t/__) ➔ translation file entry
  • process.env / import.meta.env ↔ .env definition
  • Eggjs ctx.service jump
Python (Django / Flask / FastAPI):
  • Django URL pattern ➔ view function
  • Flask/FastAPI route ➔ handler
PHP (Laravel / Symfony):
  • Laravel Route ➔ Controller method
  • Blade @include/@extends ➔ template file
  • Laravel config() ➔ config file
Ruby on Rails:
  • Rails route ➔ controller#action
  • Rails render partial ➔ partial file
  • Rails model association ➔ related model
Go / Rust / Config:
  • Go interface ➔ implementation
  • go.mod ➔ pkg.go.dev
  • Cargo.toml ➔ crates.io
  • Dockerfile FROM ➔ Docker Hub
Dependency Registry:
  • Maven pom.xml / Gradle ➔ Maven Central
  • package.json ➔ npm
  • requirements.txt / pyproject.toml ➔ PyPI
  • Gemfile ➔ RubyGems

How to use:
  • Gutter icon (left side of editor)
  • Right-click menu ➔ Smart Jump
  • Shortcut: Alt + J
  • REST Endpoint Search: Ctrl + \
